create_sagemaker_model: create a SageMaker Model with a Docker image URI, IAM role, and environment variables for model path and Hugging Face token
deploy_sagemaker_endpoint: deploy a SageMaker model endpoint on an ml.g5.12xlarge GPU instance with initial instance count of 1
create_predictor: create a SageMaker Predictor with a JSONSerializer for sending inference requests to an endpoint
send_inference_request: send a chat completion inference request with messages, max tokens, temperature, top_p, and top_k to a SageMaker endpoint
parse_inference_response: parse a SageMaker inference response by decoding bytes to UTF-8 and deserializing JSON
